test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: After allowing a discount of 10% on its marked price, the value of a washing machine is Rs. 28,800. If no discount is allowed, then the shopkeeper gains 25%. The cost price of the washing machine is:
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price after discount = Rs. 28,800,

Discount = 10%,

Gain = 25%

**Concept:**

Marked price = Selling price/(1 - Discount/100),

Cost price = Selling price/(1 + Gain/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Marked price = Rs. 28,800/(1 - 10/100) = Rs. 32,000

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 32,000/(1 + 25/100) = Rs. 25,600

**Hence, the cost price of the washing machine is Rs. 25,600.**
